purpose: Post-hoc diagnostic of opposite-direction errors and smaller neutral bands, frozen predictions only
primary_denominator: Number of frozen non-neutral predictions (up or down), not all timestamps
opposite_beyond_band: pred=up and true=down OR pred=down and true=up with the declared band
opposite_raw_sign: pred=up and return_pct<0 OR pred=down and return_pct>0, including opposite moves inside neutral band
secondary_denominator: All admissible timestamps, including neutral predictions
sensitivity_policy: Only observed labels change. Every saved probability and argmax prediction is unchanged. No comparison is a retrained smaller-band model or independent validation.
intervals: Marginal 95% paired calendar block-bootstrap intervals, reusing both registered parent banks; no winner selection or new promotion gate
